Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
So this is the Amusement Spot... looks fun♪
Now, what should we start with？
Takane
Everything looks fun... hey, I can't decide.
Let's see...
Takane
This place has become one of our usual date spots, huh♪
Let's have fun today too！
Takane
Hehe, didn't get enough play in？ Me neither！
Let's play to our hearts' content today.
Takane
Sure. I'll keep you company as long as you want.
Thanks. Then, one more time！
Takane
Knot 30 was fun. It might be good exercise for the brain？
Yeah. Getting flustered is part of the fun.
Takane
You know... apparently Knot 30 has a winning strategy for whoever goes first.
Really... huh.
Takane
Red Light, Green Light is so nostalgic. It reminds me of when I was little.
When you're a kid, you get really into simple games, huh.
Takane
"Daruma-san ga koronda"... but a daruma doll doesn't fall over, does it？
Hm？ Now that you mention it... why is it called that？
Takane
Watermelon splitting is fun. A little scary, though.
Being the one who swings looks fun too.
Takane
Watermelon is written "western melon," right？ Then what's the "southern melon"？
Huh？ ...Ah, a pumpkin！
Takane
Marshmallow catch doesn't work unless the two of us are in sync.
Kind of like doubles in tennis, maybe.
Takane
Apparently the ingredients in marshmallows were originally used by foreign kings as throat medicine.
Huh... you sure know some stuff.
Takane
Doesn't playing darts make you feel a little grown-up？
True, darts do have that image.
Takane
Apparently serious darts players have their own darts. I kind of admire that.
Haha, don't get too into it.
Takane
Speed is so tense, it might be one of my favorite card games.
True. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ seems like she'd be good at that kind of thing...
Takane
Speaking of Speed... apparently calling cards "toranpu" is only a Japanese thing？
Huh, then what do they call them overseas...？
Takane
Soap bubbles... watching them makes me feel dreamy.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s such a romantic...
Takane
I'd love to get inside a giant soap bubble just once. Is that silly？
Haha, I think it's very ▲高嶺＊＊▲, and I like it.
Takane
That game was fun！ But is it weird for a couple to bonk each other？
Hmm. Well, it's just a game.
Takane
In this game, you have to win rock-paper-scissors first, right？ You have to read your opponent's pattern...
Isn't it better to just go on reflexes without thinking too much？
Takane
This game is a battle of wits. Outsmarting each other is fun♪
Mind games, huh... that gets me fired up.
Takane
I wonder what country this game came from？
Um... isn't it from a Japanese TV show？ Just a guess.
Takane
That was fun. But I kind of feel bad for the aliens.
Really？ It makes me feel like, "Bring it on！"
Takane
Hehe, what would you do if aliens really invaded？
Then... I'd protect ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Takane
Choosing the panels is the key, huh？ If you let your guard down, it won't go well.
Maybe going by gut instinct is the way to go.
Takane
I want to link lots of panels and win lots of medals.
You end up getting pretty serious, huh.
Takane
You get slot spins for every ticket you collected on our dates.
Maybe aiming for that is a good strategy.
Takane
Too bad about the jackpot earlier. You were so close.
Remembering it makes me frustrated... next time for sure！
Takane
When you hit the jackpot earlier, I was cheering in my head.
It was all thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲ cheering for me.
Takane
Grand Cross was fun. My favorite was the Music Tour♪
It's like an amusement park, so it's fun just to watch.
Takane
You were so close to the Grand Cross jackpot. Too bad...
The reach effects were so amazing, I wanted to see the win effects too...
Takane
Congratulations on the jackpot. It was so lively, like a land of dreams♪
It was like being inside a theme park.
Takane
Someday I want to travel around World Heritage Sites, like in Fortune Trinity♪
Haha, that'd be one big adventure.
Takane
The Fortune Trinity jackpot, so close... my hands got sweaty.
If I'd cleared that part, it would've been perfect... sigh.
Takane
The Grand Cross jackpot was so exciting♪ The medals came pouring down like a waterfall.
It really felt like, "I found the treasure！"
Takane
Anima Lotta is fun. All the Anima are so cute▼
So that's another way to enjoy it. The game itself was satisfying too.
Takane
Hey, Anima Lotta was so close. So many balls fell, and still no jackpot...
I was so caught up watching the roulette lights that it ended...
Takane
The Anima Lotta jackpot was amazing. The lights were so sparkly！
It was a festival of lights and sound.
Takane
Just getting a jackpot chance is fun. My heart races wondering if we'll win.
If only I could make the most of the chance.
Takane
The most exciting part is the jackpot chance. But it's that much more disappointing when you miss.
That's the make-or-break moment... next time, we'll get it for sure！
Takane
When you hit the jackpot, your face lit right up♪
You were watching？ Haha.
Takane
When you hit the jackpot, everyone around was watching you too.
Really？ I didn't even notice.
Takane
There are so many kinds of medal games, it's hard to decide, isn't it？
Then next, let's try another medal game！
Takane
Medal games are interesting, and pretty... and fun♪
Haha, you got hooked, huh？
Takane
Look, look. So many sparkly medals！
Just playing is satisfying, but getting lots of medals really does make you happy.
Takane
That was fun♪ I hope we win lots of medals next time we come？
That was the plan... well, it was fun, so that's okay.
Takane
I had so much fun today♪ You too？
Yeah. It was really fun！
Takane
Hehe, you were totally absorbed in playing, huh？
So were you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Takane
When I play games with you, time flies.
That just means we're both having that much fun.
Takane
It's been a while since I played this much♪ It was so fun.
Haah, that felt great.
Takane
Every game is fun with you...
Playing games together really gets us fired up.
Takane
Let's come again. Promise？
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ asks, I can't say no.
Takane
We have to call it a day now... hey, when's next time？
Already talking about next time？ You must've really had fun.
Takane
But it was frustrating... let's play again. I'll do better next time.
Looks like you're not happy with the results... I'll do better next time too.
Takane
Come to think of it, I messed up partway through... I really thought I could do better.
Oh, you're frustrated... then next time is revenge.
Takane
I think I can do better next time. I feel like I got the hang of it.
Huh, then we'll have to come back soon.
All right, let's test my luck.
Silver, huh. I have to make the most of it...
A Gold Scratch, no losers！ Yes！
Oh, a Platinum Scratch... gotta aim for the big prize！
It's the legendary Premier Scratch！ This could be huge...
Takane
Just a hunch... isn't it the right one？
Takane
This time... the left！ I think.
Takane
I have a feeling it's the middle.
Takane
Hmm... any of them could be it... I don't know.
Takane
Can I leave it to you？
Takane
Because I believe in you.
Yes, a win！
Amazing... it was just like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ said.
I won！ It's thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲ cheering me on！
Ah... a miss.
...Sorry, maybe because I didn't listen to you.
